quarterly_data.quarter: Mitsubishi Heavy Industries press release: Mitsubishi Heavy Industries and Ingeteam Form Strategic (10-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Partner Ingeteam S.A.: MHI and Ingeteam signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) forming a strategic partnership to distribute, integrate and jointly develop advanced energy infrastructure solutions for U.S. data centers. The companies intend to expand the availability of Ingeteam's power conversion solutions and related software for the U.S. data center market through MHI Group, and to explore integrating selected Ingeteam technologies into energy infrastructure solutions MHI Group develops for its customers; potential future areas include advanced medium-voltage distribution and energy management systems, subject to further technical and commercial evaluation. MHI calls the MOU an initial, U.S.-focused step and says it will continue expanding its AI infrastructure portfolio (integrated power, cooling and energy management). Shin Gomi (Senior General Manager, Data Center & Energy Management Department): 'The challenge is no longer just securing power. It is delivering high-quality, reliable power to support AI workloads.'
